site_name: Land to North of Meadowlea Close
decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority is not satisfied, on the balance of probabilities, that the application site has been used continuously for a period of at least 10 years prior to the date of the application for the specific purpose described, namely a commercial equestrian use with ancillary stable, storage buildings and caravans. Such a commercial equestrian use, being materially different from the grazing of land for agricultural purposes, would amount to a material change of use of land and therefore development within the meaning of section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). No planning permission has been identified for that use, and the evidence submitted is not sufficiently precise and unambiguous to demonstrate that the use has become lawful through the passage of time under sections 191 and 171B of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. Accordingly, the applicant has failed to discharge the burden of proof and the Certificate is refused.
description: Existing use of an open field as Sui Generis (equestrian use), erection of a field stable, caravans, and outbuildings (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for Existing Use)
